description: Defines a template class StreamJSONOneShotType for single-pass JSON streaming with internal serializer and deserializer implementations, used as a helper for JSON message handling in the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: StreamJSONOneShotType
classes.description: A template class providing a one-shot streaming JSON parser with internal serialization and deserialization logic, designed for single-pass JSON data processing.

classes.name: SerializerImpl
classes.description: Handles serialization of queued interface objects into a stream, supporting JSON and MessagePack formats.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl
classes.description: Handles deserialization of incoming stream data into interface objects, supporting JSON and MessagePack formats.

classes.name: HandlerType
classes.description: A handler class inheriting from SOURCE, acting as a pass-through for data transmission and state changes.

methods.name: Link
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal channel handler.

methods.name: Received
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle received interface elements.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Pure virtual method to send interface elements.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle state changes.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits an interface element for serialization and triggers the channel if open.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the channel with a specified wait time.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Serializes data to be sent over the channel.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Deserializes received data from the channel.

methods.name: IsIdle
methods.description: Checks if the serializer and deserializer are idle.
